scope: Canonical public operation-plan export and independent Python structural validation; not full numeric execution, a real-checkpoint comparison, calibrated Gamma, GPU execution, or an E2E proof.

validated_invariants: duplicate-free JSON and exact status/context schemas
contiguous non-overlapping packed-W intervals covering 61394690560 bytes
contiguous unique source IDs and stable cross-context identities
single-producer topological DAG with complete source coverage
operator-specific keys, arities, references and canonical parameters
stable DAG across contexts except the canonical RoPE start position

checks.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_OPT_LEVEL=2 timeout -k 5s 60s cargo clippy --offline --locked -j1 -p volta-pcs --features c71-b12-pcs --example c71_calibration -- -D clippy::correctness -D clippy::suspicious
checks.note: Only pre-existing lints outside the denied correctness and suspicious groups were emitted.

checks.command: C71_CALIBRATION_BINARY=$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/c71_calibration PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=$PWD/scripts .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_c71_calibration.py tests/test_c71_calibration_oracle.py tests/test_c71_calibration_trace.py

non_code_failure.command: python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_c71_calibration.py tests/test_c71_calibration_oracle.py tests/test_c71_calibration_trace.py
non_code_failure.reason: The system Python lacks NumPy; the prescribed project .venv invocation above passed.
